query: SELECT sp.id, sp.url, sp.page_title, sp.status, COUNT(cs.id) as section_count FROM scraped_pages sp LEFT JOIN content_sections cs ON sp.id = cs.page_id GROUP BY sp.id ORDER BY sp.id DESC LIMIT 10;
